description: The 'Get Movin' step 8 report: the tutorial tells a pad player to grab the Battlewagon with A and spin it with LB/RB, but the grab never took and the bumpers answered 'Confirm or reset this unit's move before switching'. Root cause: PadRouter's pickup stands down while the virtual cursor is ACTIVE (A belongs to the cursor then) and the cursor goes active on ANY left-stick deflection — so the moment the player steers onto the hull, A was re-emitted as a plain left click that started a drag and ended it in the same flush (a 0-inch re-stage) leaving nothing in hand, and the bumpers fell through to _cycle()'s unit switch. Driven here with a Shield-captain on Dawneagle Jetbike (oval 75mm base — the same pivot-capable geometry as the wagon): mode via the pad action bar, a bumper turn with nothing staged, a carry + drop, then the reported path — glide the cursor onto the model's own hull (cursor ACTIVE) and press A, which must GRAB it — two LB taps for 30 degrees, a drop, and a bumper turn in the parked/staged state. Start then confirms and the facing must survive into GameState (the staged move carries the rotation, so a turn applied while parked has to re-stage or the confirm reverts it).

steps.comment: the pivot-capable geometry this scenario needs — a circular base has no facing to turn
claims pad mode AND activates the virtual cursor - the state a real player is always in after steering

lock the mode the way the tutorial's own previous step does - glide onto the button and press A. Deliberately NOT the pad action bar, so the bumper checks below run from the MODE-LOCKED-BUT-NOTHING-STAGED state
the mode lock alone refuses a unit switch, which is why the bumpers are free to rotate here
LB with nothing staged: turn the model on the spot (no staged move exists to re-stage, so the facing lives in GameState + move_data.original_rotations, which is what undo reads)
one tap = 15 degrees left
the bar must ADVERTISE the bumpers wherever they turn the model - a discoverable binding, not a hidden one. (The bar recomputes on pad input, so it is read AFTER the press, not before it.)
and a turn is not a move: rotating an un-dropped model must not invent a staged move for it
the bumper did not switch units
the rotation borrows selected_model and hands it straight back - a phantom selection would change what the next click does
back onto the hull with the cursor still ACTIVE - the state the tutorial's 'grab it wiv A' step leaves the player in, having just steered onto a panel button
A grabs the model
RED before the fix: the press was a click that picked the model up and dropped it again in the same gesture
drop the first leg (2.5in of the jetbike's move)
the drop parked the cursor ON the model, so glide away first - otherwise the runner's 'already within 4px' early-out returns without re-activating the cursor and the reported state is never reached
THE PLAYER'S STATE: steer the cursor back onto your own model, which is what 'grab it wiv A' asks for
A on your OWN model mid-move must GRAB it (a carry), not click-and-release it in place
RED before the fix: VirtualCursor consumed A as a left click, _try_begin_carry bailed on is_cursor_active() and carry_active stayed false
the controller-side half of the same grab - the model really is in hand, not merely flagged in the router
the router's model focus follows the model the player aimed at, so D-pad hops / X-finish continue from it
two more LB taps on top of the first: -3 x 15 degrees = -PI/4, the same 15-a-tap Q/E gives the keyboard
drop it where it now points
distance spent before the parked turn below, for the no-free-inches check
RB with nothing in hand but the move session locked: switching units is refused in this state, so the bumper turns the model instead of only scolding the player
the session lock still holds - no unit switch
RED before the fix: the bumper only showed 'Confirm or reset this unit's move before switching'. -PI/4 + PI/12 = -PI/6
the parked turn re-stages the SAME model at the SAME dest - it must replace its staged entry, not add a second one
and the re-stage spends no inches: dest == the existing staged dest, so the distance is unchanged (a turn costs the pivot, not travel)
Start confirms the unit's move
the facing survives the confirm: CONFIRM_UNIT_MOVE writes the STAGED rotation back over the model, so a turn applied while parked must re-stage or it is silently reverted here
and the move itself landed: the turns did not disturb the staged destination
